summary.content:
Today's selection covers 65 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Meta’s new Muse Image model can pull other Instagram users into AI photos
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Big Brand Jobs Scam Targets Marketing Pros' Google Accounts
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 34 articles published in the last 24 hours
